title: Queues invokes made before handshake
description: Verifies that invoke calls made before the ready message are queued and flushed after handshake completes.
given: A client with no handshake completed yet
when: invoke('echo', {text: 'queued'}) is called before ready, then ready arrives
then: Only hello is posted initially, the invoke request is posted after ready, and the promise resolves correctly
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::queues an invoke made before handshake and flushes it on ready
